name: Ogee Court
summary: A broad arcade gathers beneath an ogee dome, with a rounded minaret woven into its right wall.
why: Three true arch openings share one curved foundation. The large dome and central doorway share x=48; the minaret crown, shaft, and side wall physically meet. A terracotta architectural facet follows the tower instead of floating above it.
risk: The bulbous roof is deliberately ornamental. At 24px the three arches simplify into an open arcade.
sub1: A curved roof grows out of the hall
sub2: Crown and shaft join the side wall
reasonToChoose: You want recognizably Islamic architecture with a softer, ornamental silhouette.
